# AAS Graph Schema

All nodes also carry the label `GraphNode`.

## Core Nodes

### AssetAdministrationShell
The top-level AAS entity.
- Labels: AssetAdministrationShell, Identifiable, Referable, Refe

args.cypher:
MATCH (aas:AssetAdministrationShell)
RETURN aas.idShort AS aas_id_short, aas.id AS aas_id, aas.category AS aas_category
ORDER BY aas.idShort
LIMIT 100

MATCH (aas:AssetAdministrationShell {idShort: 'Hall4'})
RETURN aas.idShort AS aas_id_short, aas.id AS aas_id, aas.category AS aas_category

MATCH (aas:AssetAdministrationShell {idShort: 'Hall4'})
      -[:HAS_SUBMODEL]->(sm:Submodel)
OPTIONAL MATCH (sm)-[:HAS_SEMANTIC_ID]->(sc:SemanticConcept)
RETURN sm.idShort AS submodel_id_short, sm.id AS submodel_id, sc.id AS semantic_id

MATCH (sm:Submodel {idShort: 'Nameplate'})
      -[:HAS_ELEMENT*]->(el:SubmodelElement)
RETURN el.idShort AS element_id_short, labels(el) AS element_type, el.category AS element_category

MATCH (sm:Submodel {idShort: 'Nameplate'})
      -[:HAS_ELEMENT*]->(el:SubmodelElement)
WHERE el.idShort IN ['SerialNumber','ManufacturerName','ManufacturerProductFamily','ManufacturerProductType']
RETURN el.idShort, el.value, el.valueType

MATCH (aas:AssetAdministrationShell {idShort: 'Hall4'})
      -[:HAS_SUBMODEL]->(sm:Submodel)
      -[:HAS_SEMANTIC_ID]->(sc:SemanticConcept)
RETURN sc.id AS semantic_id
